# instruction.md

## Poster Brief: Coding AI Leaderboard

You're creating a portrait-format social media poster that showcases the 20 fastest-rising open-source coding AI repositories on GitHub for the week of April 9–15, 2026. The audience is developers, tech enthusiasts, and AI community members scrolling social feeds — so the poster needs to be instantly scannable and visually compelling.

### Purpose & Key Message

The poster should communicate one thing fast: **which coding AI projects are exploding in popularity right now.** The dominant story is hermes-agent's massive +9,715 star lead, and the broader narrative is that agent frameworks and the Claude Code ecosystem are the hottest trends this week.

### Priorities

- **The full Top 20 ranking table is the centerpiece.** It should be clean, legible, and take up the most real estate. Think leaderboard energy — rank numbers, repo names, star counts, and movement indicators at a glance.
- **The four headline metrics (~48k total stars, 9 repos above 2k, 5 Claude-related repos, hermes-agent's +9,715) should sit prominently** near the top as bold stat callouts to hook attention before the viewer dives into the table.
- **The thematic clusters** (agent frameworks, Claude Code ecosystem, etc.) should be visually distinct — use color-coded tags or category labels so trends pop without requiring deep reading.

### Visual & Style Guidance

Go **dark mode** — deep charcoal or near-black background with vibrant accent colors (electric blue, green, amber) for data highlights. The tone is data-forward and modern: think GitHub's aesthetic crossed with a Bloomberg terminal. Use a monospace or geometric sans-serif font for numbers and rankings. Keep decorative elements minimal — let the data breathe. Star icons (⭐) or subtle GitHub-style iconography can reinforce the theme without cluttering.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data, key messages).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for poster requirements, sections, metrics, and style definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output the final poster to `/app/output/final_poster.png`.
2. The poster must be a single self-contained image file.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — do not pause, ask questions, or wait for a reply. When encountering BLOCKING or wait-for-user instructions, make a professional judgment and continue.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `poster.tone`, `poster.audience`, etc., use them to choose templates, palettes, and styles. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

# Coding AI Leaderboard: Weekly GitHub Star Growth (Apr 9–15, 2026)

## Overview

The Coding AI Leaderboard tracks the open-source repositories gaining the most GitHub stars each week. The data below covers the week of **April 9–15, 2026**, capturing a period of intense community activity around AI agent frameworks, Claude Code tooling, and developer productivity utilities. A total of roughly **48,000 new stars** were distributed across the top 20 entries alone.

## Top 20 Weekly Rankings

| Rank | Trend | Repository | Weekly Stars |
|------|-------|------------------------------------------|--------------|
| 1 | — | NousResearch/hermes-agent | +9,715 |
| 2 | ▲ | forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills | +4,917 |
| 3 | — | JuliusBrussee/caveman | +4,407 |
| 4 | ▼ | MemPalace/mempalace | +3,524 |
| 5 | — | VoltAgent/awesome-design-md | +3,246 |
| 6 | ▲ | microsoft/markitdown | +3,048 |
| 7 | ▼ | safishamsi/graphify | +2,763 |
| 8 | ▲ | obra/superpowers | +2,180 |
| 9 | ▲ | shanraisshan/claude-code-best-practice | +2,151 |
| 10 | — | affaan-m/everything-claude-code | +1,978 |
| 11 | ▲ | thedotmack/claude-mem | +1,828 |
| 12 | ▼ | santifer/career-ops | +1,788 |
| 13 | ▲ | multica-ai/multica | +1,506 |
| 14 | ▲ | shiyu-coder/Kronos | +1,286 |
| 15 | ▼ | ultraworkers/claw-code | +1,285 |
| 16 | ▼ | openclaw/openclaw | +1,268 |
| 17 | ▼ | OpenBMB/VoxCPM | +1,266 |
| 18 | ▼ | addyosmani/agent-skills | +1,195 |
| 19 | — | rtk-ai/rtk | +1,098 |
| 20 | N | garrytan/gstack | +1,012 |

## Dominant Leader: hermes-agent

NousResearch's **hermes-agent** claimed the number-one spot with **+9,715 stars** in a single week — nearly double the second-place entry. The repository provides an open-source agent framework built on the Hermes model family, and its explosive growth signals strong developer demand for fully open agent tooling that can rival proprietary alternatives.

## The Claude Code Ecosystem Surge

Five of the top 20 repositories are directly related to Anthropic's Claude Code product:

- **claude-code-best-practice** (#9, +2,151) — curated best-practice guides
- **everything-claude-code** (#10, +1,978) — comprehensive resource collection
- **claude-mem** (#11, +1,828) — memory management plugin
- **claw-code** (#15, +1,285) — alternative CLI wrapper
- **openclaw** (#16, +1,268) — open-source Claude Code extension framework

Together these five repos accumulated over **8,500 stars**, underscoring how quickly a third-party ecosystem is forming around Claude Code.

## Other Notable Trends

- **AI-assisted design** is gaining traction: VoltAgent's awesome-design-md (#5, +3,246) curates design resources in Markdown, while graphify (#7, +2,763) converts data into visual graphs using AI.
- **Microsoft's markitdown** (#6, +3,048) continues its steady climb, converting documents to Markdown for LLM ingestion — a utility play that benefits the entire AI stack.
- **New entry gstack** (#20, +1,012) by Garry Tan debuted on the leaderboard, focusing on a full-stack AI development toolkit.

## Key Takeaways

1. **Agent-first development is surging** — hermes-agent's nearly 10k weekly stars dwarf every other entry.
2. **Claude Code's ecosystem is expanding fast** — 25% of the top 20 repos orbit a single product.
3. **Utility and infrastructure tools** like markitdown show that foundational open-source packages continue to attract sustained interest alongside flashier agent projects.

*Data sourced from star-history.com, week of April 9–15, 2026.*

# Coding AI Leaderboard: Weekly GitHub Star Growth (Apr 9–15, 2026)

## Overview

The Coding AI Leaderboard tracks the open-source repositories gaining the most GitHub stars each week. The data below covers the week of **April 9–15, 2026**, capturing a period of intense community activity around AI agent frameworks, Claude Code tooling, and developer productivity utilities. A total of roughly **48,000 new stars** were distributed across the top 20 entries alone.

## Top 20 Weekly Rankings

| Rank | Trend | Repository | Weekly Stars |
|------|-------|------------------------------------------|--------------|
| 1 | — | NousResearch/hermes-agent | +9,715 |

| 15 | ▼ | ultraworkers/claw-code | +1,285 |

| 17 | ▼ | OpenBMB/VoxCPM | +1,266 |
| 18 | ▼ | addyosmani/agent-skills | +1,195 |
| 19 | — | rtk-ai/rtk | +1,098 |
| 20 | N | garrytan/gstack | +1,012 |

## Dominant Leader: hermes-agent

NousResearch's **hermes-agent** claimed the number-one spot with **+9,715 stars** in a single week — nearly double the second-place entry. The repository provides an open-source agent framework built on the Hermes model family, and its explosive growth signals strong developer demand for fully open agent tooling that can rival proprietary alternatives.

## The Claude Code Ecosystem Surge

Five of the top 20 repositories are directly related to Anthropic's Claude Code product:

- **claude-code-best-practice** (#9, +2,151) — curated best-practice guides
- **everything-claude-code** (#10, +1,978) — comprehensive resource collection
- **claude-mem** (#11, +1,828) — memory management plugin
- **claw-code** (#15, +1,285) — alternative CLI wrapper
- **openclaw** (#16, +1,268) — open-source Claude Code extension framework

Together these five repos accumulated over **8,500 stars**, underscoring how quickly a third-party ecosystem is forming around Claude Code.

## Other Notable Trends

- **AI-assisted design** is gaining traction: VoltAgent's awesome-design-md (#5, +3,246) curates design resources in Markdown, while graphify (#7, +2,763) converts data into visual graphs using AI.
- **Microsoft's markitdown** (#6, +3,048) continues its steady climb, converting documents to Markdown for LLM ingestion — a utility play that benefits the entire AI stack.
- **New entry gstack** (#20, +1,012) by Garry Tan debuted on the leaderboard, focusing on a full-stack AI development toolkit.

## Key Takeaways

1. **Agent-first development is surging** — hermes-agent's nearly 10k weekly stars dwarf every other entry.
2. **Claude Code's ecosystem is expanding fast** — 25% of the top 20 repos orbit a single product.
3. **Utility and infrastructure tools** like markitdown show that foundational open-source packages continue to attract sustained interest alongside flashier agent projects.

*Data sourced from star-history.com, week of April 9–15, 2026.*

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a dark-mode Coding AI Leaderboard poster."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import textwrap

# ── Canvas ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 1080, 1920
BG = (13, 17, 23)           # GitHub dark bg #0d1117

TEXT_PRIMARY = (230, 237, 243)   # #e6edf3
TEXT_SECONDARY = (139, 148, 158) # #8b949e
TEXT_MUTED = (110, 118, 129)     # #6e7681

# Accent colors
ELECTRIC_BLUE = (88, 166, 255)   # #58a6ff
GREEN = (63, 185, 80)            # #3fb950
AMBER = (210, 153, 34)           # #d29922
RED_SOFT = (248, 81, 73)         # #f85149
PURPLE = (188, 140, 255)         # #bc8cff

# Category colors
CAT_AGENT = (88, 166, 255)       # Blue - Agent frameworks
CAT_CLAUDE = (188, 140, 255)     # Purple - Claude Code ecosystem
CAT_DESIGN = (210, 153, 34)      # Amber - Design / visualization
CAT_UTILITY = (63, 185, 80)      # Green - Utilities / infra
CAT_NEW = (255, 123, 164)        # Pink - New entry
CAT_OTHER = (139, 148, 158)      # Gray - Other

# ── Fonts ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FONT_DIR = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype"
def font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(f"{FONT_DIR}/{name}", size)

FONT_TITLE = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", 42)
FONT_SUBTITLE = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 20)
FONT_METRIC_VAL = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", 30)
FONT_METRIC_LABEL = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 13)
FONT_METRIC_CTX = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 11)

FONT_TAKEAWAY_TITLE = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", 18)
FONT_TAKEAWAY_BODY = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 14)
FONT_TAG = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", 10)
FONT_FOOTER = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 12)
FONT_STAR = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 16)
FONT_SECTION = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", 20)

# ── Data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
REPOS = [
    {"rank": 1,  "trend": "—", "repo": "NousResearch/hermes-agent",      "stars": "+9,715",  "cat": "agent"},
    {"rank": 2,  "trend": "▲", "repo": "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills", "stars": "+4,917", "cat": "utility"},
    {"rank": 3,  "trend": "—", "repo": "JuliusBrussee/caveman",          "stars": "+4,407",  "cat": "other"},
    {"rank": 4,  "trend": "▼", "repo": "MemPalace/mempalace",            "stars": "+3,524",  "cat": "other"},
    {"rank": 5,  "trend": "—", "repo": "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md",    "stars": "+3,246",  "cat": "design"},
    {"rank": 6,  "trend": "▲", "repo": "microsoft/markitdown",           "stars": "+3,048",  "cat": "utility"},
    {"rank": 7,  "trend": "▼", "repo": "safishamsi/graphify",            "stars": "+2,763",  "cat": "design"},
    {"rank": 8,  "trend": "▲", "repo": "obra/superpowers",               "stars": "+2,180",  "cat": "other"},
    {"rank": 9,  "trend": "▲", "repo": "shanraisshan/claude-code-best-practice", "stars": "+2,151", "cat": "claude"},
    {"rank": 10, "trend": "—", "repo": "affaan-m/everything-claude-code","stars": "+1,978",  "cat": "claude"},
    {"rank": 11, "trend": "▲", "repo": "thedotmack/claude-mem",          "stars": "+1,828",  "cat": "claude"},
    {"rank": 12, "trend": "▼", "repo": "santifer/career-ops",            "stars": "+1,788",  "cat": "other"},
    {"rank": 13, "trend": "▲", "repo": "multica-ai/multica",             "stars": "+1,506",  "cat": "agent"},
    {"rank": 14, "trend": "▲", "repo": "shiyu-coder/Kronos",             "stars": "+1,286",  "cat": "other"},
    {"rank": 15, "trend": "▼", "repo": "ultraworkers/claw-code",         "stars": "+1,285",  "cat": "claude"},
    {"rank": 16, "trend": "▼", "repo": "openclaw/openclaw",              "stars": "+1,268",  "cat": "claude"},
    {"rank": 17, "trend": "▼", "repo": "OpenBMB/VoxCPM",                "stars": "+1,266",  "cat": "other"},
    {"rank": 18, "trend": "▼", "repo": "addyosmani/agent-skills",        "stars": "+1,195",  "cat": "agent"},
    {"rank": 19, "trend": "—", "repo": "rtk-ai/rtk",                     "stars": "+1,098",  "cat": "other"},
    {"rank": 20, "trend": "N", "repo": "garrytan/gstack",                "stars": "+1,012",  "cat": "new"},
]

METRICS = [
    {"label": "Top Weekly Gain", "value": "+9,715", "ctx": "hermes-agent"},
    {"label": "Repos 2k+ Stars", "value": "10", "ctx": "Half the top 20"},
    {"label": "Claude-Related", "value": "5", "ctx": "Ecosystem surge"},
    {"label": "Total Stars", "value": "~48k", "ctx": "Across top 20"},
]

CAT_LABELS = {
    "agent": ("AGENT", CAT_AGENT),
    "claude": ("CLAUDE", CAT_CLAUDE),
    "design": ("DESIGN", CAT_DESIGN),
    "utility": ("UTIL", CAT_UTILITY),
    "new": ("NEW", CAT_NEW),
    "other": ("OTHER", CAT_OTHER),
}

TAKEAWAYS = [
    ("Agent-first dev is surging", "hermes-agent's ~10k weekly stars dwarf every other entry, signaling massive demand for open agent tooling."),
    ("Claude Code ecosystem expanding fast", "25% of the top 20 repos orbit a single product — a third-party tooling wave is underway."),
    ("Utility & infra tools endure", "Projects like markitdown show foundational open-source packages attract sustained interest alongside flashier agents."),
]

# ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

def draw_tag(draw, x, y, label, color):
    """Draw a small colored tag/pill."""
    tw = len(label) * 7 + 12
    th = 16
    # Filled pill with slight transparency effect
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x + tw, y + th], radius=4,
                           fill=(color[0]//4, color[1]//4, color[2]//4),
                           outline=color, width=1)
    draw.text((x + 6, y + 2), label, fill=color, font=FONT_TAG)

def center_text(draw, y, text, font, fill, w=W):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    draw.text(((w - tw) // 2, y), text, fill=fill, font=font)

def draw_bar(draw, x, y, width, max_width, color, height=4):
    """Draw a horizontal bar chart segment."""
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x + width, y + height], radius=2, fill=color)

# ── Build Image ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

y = 0

# ── Header area ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
HEADER_H = 120
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, HEADER_H], fill=(10, 12, 18))
# Subtle top accent line
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 3], fill=ELECTRIC_BLUE)

y = 20
# Star icon + title
draw.text((36, y), "⭐", fill=AMBER, font=ImageFont.truetype(f"{FONT_DIR}/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 36))
draw.text((78, y + 2), "Coding AI Leaderboard", fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=FONT_TITLE)
y += 50
draw.text((78, y), "Top GitHub Repos by Weekly Star Growth  ·  Apr 9–15, 2026", fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=FONT_SUBTITLE)

# Thin separator
y = HEADER_H
draw.rectangle([36, y, W - 36, y + 1], fill=BORDER)

# ── Metrics row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
y = HEADER_H + 16
METRIC_CARD_W = (W - 36 * 2 - 12 * 3) // 4  # 4 cards with gaps
METRIC_CARD_H = 90
mx = 36

for i, m in enumerate(METRICS):
    # Card background
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, [mx, y, mx + METRIC_CARD_W, y + METRIC_CARD_H],
                      radius=8, fill=BG_CARD, outline=BORDER, width=1)
    # Accent top line on card
    accent_colors = [ELECTRIC_BLUE, GREEN, PURPLE, AMBER]
    draw.rectangle([mx + 1, y + 1, mx + METRIC_CARD_W - 1, y + 3], fill=accent_colors[i])

    # Value
    draw.text((mx + 14, y + 10), m["value"], fill=accent_colors[i], font=FONT_METRIC_VAL)
    # Label
    draw.text((mx + 14, y + 48), m["label"], fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=FONT_METRIC_LABEL)
    # Context
    draw.text((mx + 14, y + 66), m["ctx"], fill=TEXT_MUTED, font=FONT_METRIC_CTX)

    mx += METRIC_CARD_W + 12

y += METRIC_CARD_H + 18

# ── Category legend ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
draw.text((36, y), "CATEGORIES", fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=FONT_TAG)
lx = 130
for cat_key, (cat_label, cat_color) in [
    ("agent", CAT_AGENT), ("claude", CAT_CLAUDE), ("design", CAT_DESIGN),
    ("utility", CAT_UTILITY), ("new", CAT_NEW),
]:
    draw_tag(draw, lx, y - 1, cat_label, cat_color)
    lx += len(cat_label) * 7 + 24

y += 26

# ── Section title ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
draw.text((36, y), "Full Weekly Top 20 Ranking", fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=FONT_SECTION)
y += 30

# ── Table ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TABLE_X = 28
TABLE_W = W - 56
COL_RANK_W = 42
COL_TREND_W = 28
COL_REPO_W = 440
COL_BAR_W = 220
COL_STARS_W = 100
ROW_H = 48

# Table header
draw_rounded_rect(draw, [TABLE_X, y, TABLE_X + TABLE_W, y + ROW_H],
                  radius=6, fill=(30, 36, 44))
hx = TABLE_X + 12
draw.text((hx, y + 14), "#", fill=TEXT_MUTED, font=FONT_TABLE_HEADER)
hx += COL_RANK_W
draw.text((hx, y + 14), "", fill=TEXT_MUTED, font=FONT_TABLE_HEADER)  # trend col
hx += COL_TREND_W
draw.text((hx, y + 14), "Repository", fill=TEXT_MUTED, font=FONT_TABLE_HEADER)
hx += COL_REPO_W
draw.text((hx, y + 14), "Weekly Stars", fill=TEXT_MUTED, font=FONT_TABLE_HEADER)

y += ROW_H

# Max stars for bar scaling
MAX_STARS = 9715

for r in REPOS:
    rank = r["rank"]
    trend = r["trend"]
    repo = r["repo"]
    stars = r["stars"]
    cat = r["cat"]

    # Row background
    row_bg = BG_ROW_EVEN if rank % 2 == 0 else BG_ROW_ODD
    # Special highlight for #1
    if rank == 1:
        row_bg = (20, 28, 40)  # Slightly bluer for #1
    draw.rectangle([TABLE_X, y, TABLE_X + TABLE_W, y + ROW_H], fill=row_bg)

    # Bottom border
    draw.rectangle([TABLE_X, y + ROW_H - 1, TABLE_X + TABLE_W, y + ROW_H], fill=(30, 35, 42))

    rx = TABLE_X + 12

    # Rank number
    rank_color = AMBER if rank <= 3 else TEXT_PRIMARY

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a dark-mode Coding AI Leaderboard poster."""

from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import textwrap

# ── Canvas ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
W, H = 1080, 1920
BG = (13, 17, 23)           # GitHub dark bg #0d1117
BG_CARD = (22, 27, 34)      # #161b22
BG_ROW_EVEN = (18, 22, 28)
BG_ROW_ODD = (25, 30, 38)
BORDER = (48, 54, 61)       # #30363d
TEXT_PRIMARY = (230, 237, 243)   # #e6edf3
TEXT_SECONDARY = (139, 148, 158) # #8b949e
TEXT_MUTED = (110, 118, 129)     # #6e7681

# Accent colors
ELECTRIC_BLUE = (88, 166, 255)   # #58a6ff
GREEN = (63, 185, 80)            # #3fb950
AMBER = (210, 153, 34)           # #d29922
RED_SOFT = (248, 81, 73)         # #f85149
PURPLE = (188, 140, 255)         # #bc8cff
CYAN = (121, 192, 255)           # #79c0ff
PINK = (255, 123, 164)           # #ff7ba4
TEAL = (63, 185, 170)            # #3fb9aa

# Category colors
CAT_AGENT = (88, 166, 255)       # Blue - Agent frameworks
CAT_CLAUDE = (188, 140, 255)     # Purple - Claude Code ecosystem
CAT_DESIGN = (210, 153, 34)      # Amber - Design / visualization
CAT_UTILITY = (63, 185, 80)      # Green - Utilities / infra
CAT_NEW = (255, 123, 164)        # Pink - New entry
CAT_OTHER = (139, 148, 158)      # Gray - Other

# ── Fonts ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
FONT_DIR = "/usr/share/fonts/truetype"
def font(name, size):
    return ImageFont.truetype(f"{FONT_DIR}/{name}", size)

FONT_TITLE = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", 42)
FONT_SUBTITLE = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 20)
FONT_METRIC_VAL = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", 30)
FONT_METRIC_LABEL = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 13)
FONT_METRIC_CTX = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 11)
FONT_TABLE_HEADER = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", 16)
FONT_TABLE_RANK = font("liberation/LiberationMono-Bold.ttf", 18)
FONT_TABLE_REPO = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 15)
FONT_TABLE_STARS = font("liberation/LiberationMono-Bold.ttf", 17)
FONT_TABLE_TREND = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 14)
FONT_TAKEAWAY_TITLE = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", 18)
FONT_TAKEAWAY_BODY = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 14)
FONT_TAG = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", 10)
FONT_FOOTER = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 12)
FONT_STAR = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 16)
FONT_SECTION = font("dejavu/DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", 20)

# ── Data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
REPOS = [
    {"rank": 1,  "trend": "—", "repo": "NousResearch/hermes-agent",      "stars": "+9,715",  "cat": "agent"},
    {"rank": 2,  "trend": "▲", "repo": "forrestchang/andrej-karpathy-skills", "stars": "+4,917", "cat": "utility"},
    {"rank": 3,  "trend": "—", "repo": "JuliusBrussee/caveman",          "stars": "+4,407",  "cat": "other"},
    {"rank": 4,  "trend": "▼", "repo": "MemPalace/mempalace",            "stars": "+3,524",  "cat": "other"},
    {"rank": 5,  "trend": "—", "repo": "VoltAgent/awesome-design-md",    "stars": "+3,246",  "cat": "design"},
    {"rank": 6,  "trend": "▲", "repo": "microsoft/markitdown",           "stars": "+3,048",  "cat": "utility"},
    {"rank": 7,  "trend": "▼", "repo": "safishamsi/graphify",            "stars": "+2,763",  "cat": "design"},
    {"rank": 8,  "trend": "▲", "repo": "obra/superpowers",               "stars": "+2,180",  "cat": "other"},
    {"rank": 9,  "trend": "▲", "repo": "shanraisshan/claude-code-best-practice", "stars": "+2,151", "cat": "claude"},
    {"rank": 10, "trend": "—", "repo": "affaan-m/everything-claude-code","stars": "+1,978",  "cat": "claude"},
    {"rank": 11, "trend": "▲", "repo": "thedotmack/claude-mem",          "stars": "+1,828",  "cat": "claude"},
    {"rank": 12, "trend": "▼", "repo": "santifer/career-ops",            "stars": "+1,788",  "cat": "other"},
    {"rank": 13, "trend": "▲", "repo": "multica-ai/multica",             "stars": "+1,506",  "cat": "agent"},
    {"rank": 14, "trend": "▲", "repo": "shiyu-coder/Kronos",             "stars": "+1,286",  "cat": "other"},
    {"rank": 15, "trend": "▼", "repo": "ultraworkers/claw-code",         "stars": "+1,285",  "cat": "claude"},
    {"rank": 16, "trend": "▼", "repo": "openclaw/openclaw",              "stars": "+1,268",  "cat": "claude"},
    {"rank": 17, "trend": "▼", "repo": "OpenBMB/VoxCPM",                "stars": "+1,266",  "cat": "other"},
    {"rank": 18, "trend": "▼", "repo": "addyosmani/agent-skills",        "stars": "+1,195",  "cat": "agent"},
    {"rank": 19, "trend": "—", "repo": "rtk-ai/rtk",                     "stars": "+1,098",  "cat": "other"},
    {"rank": 20, "trend": "N", "repo": "garrytan/gstack",                "stars": "+1,012",  "cat": "new"},
]

METRICS = [
    {"label": "Top Weekly Gain", "value": "+9,715", "ctx": "hermes-agent"},
    {"label": "Repos 2k+ Stars", "value": "10", "ctx": "Half the top 20"},
    {"label": "Claude-Related", "value": "5", "ctx": "Ecosystem surge"},
    {"label": "Total Stars", "value": "~48k", "ctx": "Across top 20"},
]

CAT_LABELS = {
    "agent": ("AGENT", CAT_AGENT),
    "claude": ("CLAUDE", CAT_CLAUDE),
    "design": ("DESIGN", CAT_DESIGN),
    "utility": ("UTIL", CAT_UTILITY),
    "new": ("NEW", CAT_NEW),
    "other": ("OTHER", CAT_OTHER),
}

TAKEAWAYS = [
    ("Agent-first dev is surging", "hermes-agent's ~10k weekly stars dwarf every other entry, signaling massive demand for open agent tooling."),
    ("Claude Code ecosystem expanding fast", "25% of the top 20 repos orbit a single product — a third-party tooling wave is underway."),
    ("Utility & infra tools endure", "Projects like markitdown show foundational open-source packages attract sustained interest alongside flashier agents."),
]

# ── Helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def draw_rounded_rect(draw, xy, radius, fill=None, outline=None, width=1):
    x0, y0, x1, y1 = xy
    draw.rounded_rectangle(xy, radius=radius, fill=fill, outline=outline, width=width)

def draw_tag(draw, x, y, label, color):
    """Draw a small colored tag/pill."""
    tw = len(label) * 7 + 12
    th = 16
    # Filled pill with slight transparency effect
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x + tw, y + th], radius=4,
                           fill=(color[0]//4, color[1]//4, color[2]//4),
                           outline=color, width=1)
    draw.text((x + 6, y + 2), label, fill=color, font=FONT_TAG)

def center_text(draw, y, text, font, fill, w=W):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    tw = bbox[2] - bbox[0]
    draw.text(((w - tw) // 2, y), text, fill=fill, font=font)

def draw_bar(draw, x, y, width, max_width, color, height=4):
    """Draw a horizontal bar chart segment."""
    draw.rounded_rectangle([x, y, x + width, y + height], radius=2, fill=color)

# ── Build Image ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

y = 0

# ── Header area ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
HEADER_H = 120
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, HEADER_H], fill=(10, 12, 18))
# Subtle top accent line
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 3], fill=ELECTRIC_BLUE)

y = 20
# Star icon + title
draw.text((36, y), "⭐", fill=AMBER, font=ImageFont.truetype(f"{FONT_DIR}/dejavu/DejaVuSans.ttf", 36))
draw.text((78, y + 2), "Coding AI Leaderboard", fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=FONT_TITLE)
y += 50
draw.text((78, y), "Top GitHub Repos by Weekly Star Growth  ·  Apr 9–15, 2026", fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=FONT_SUBTITLE)

# Thin separator
y = HEADER_H
draw.rectangle([36, y, W - 36, y + 1], fill=BORDER)

# ── Metrics row ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
y = HEADER_H + 16
METRIC_CARD_W = (W - 36 * 2 - 12 * 3) // 4  # 4 cards with gaps
METRIC_CARD_H = 90
mx = 36

for i, m in enumerate(METRICS):
    # Card background
    draw_rounded_rect(draw, [mx, y, mx + METRIC_CARD_W, y + METRIC_CARD_H],
                      radius=8, fill=BG_CARD, outline=BORDER, width=1)
    # Accent top line on card
    accent_colors = [ELECTRIC_BLUE, GREEN, PURPLE, AMBER]
    draw.rectangle([mx + 1, y + 1, mx + METRIC_CARD_W - 1, y + 3], fill=accent_colors[i])

    # Value
    draw.text((mx + 14, y + 10), m["value"], fill=accent_colors[i], font=FONT_METRIC_VAL)
    # Label
    draw.text((mx + 14, y + 48), m["label"], fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=FONT_METRIC_LABEL)
    # Context
    draw.text((mx + 14, y + 66), m["ctx"], fill=TEXT_MUTED, font=FONT_METRIC_CTX)

    mx += METRIC_CARD_W + 12

y += METRIC_CARD_H + 18

# ── Category legend ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
draw.text((36, y), "CATEGORIES", fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=FONT_TAG)
lx = 130
for cat_key in ["agent", "claude", "design", "utility", "new"]:
    cat_label, cat_color = CAT_LABELS[cat_key]
    draw_tag(draw, lx, y - 1, cat_label, cat_color)
    lx += len(cat_label) * 7 + 24

y += 26

# ── Section title ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
draw.text((36, y), "Full Weekly Top 20 Ranking", fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=FONT_SECTION)
y += 30

# ── Table ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TABLE_X = 28
TABLE_W = W - 56
COL_RANK_W = 42
COL_TREND_W = 28
COL_REPO_W = 440
COL_BAR_W = 220
COL_STARS_W = 100
ROW_H = 48

# Table header
draw_rounded_rect(draw, [TABLE_X, y, TABLE_X + TABLE_W, y + ROW_H],
                  radius=6, fill=(30, 36, 44))
hx = TABLE_X + 12
draw.text((hx, y + 14), "#", fill=TEXT_MUTED, font=FONT_TABLE_HEADER)
hx += COL_RANK_W
draw.text((hx, y + 14), "", fill=TEXT_MUTED, font=FONT_TABLE_HEADER)  # trend col
hx += COL_TREND_W
draw.text((hx, y + 14), "Repository", fill=TEXT_MUTED, font=FONT_TABLE_HEADER)
hx += COL_REPO_W
draw.text((hx, y + 14), "Weekly Stars", fill=TEXT_MUTED, font=FONT_TABLE_HEADER)

y += ROW_H

# Max stars for bar scaling
MAX_STARS = 9715

for r in REPOS:
    rank = r["rank"]
    trend = r["trend"]
    repo = r["repo"]
    stars = r["stars"]
    cat = r["cat"]

    # Row background
    row_bg = BG_ROW_EVEN if rank % 2 == 0 else BG_ROW_ODD
    # Special highlight for #1
    if rank == 1:
        row_bg = (20, 28, 40)  # Slightly bluer for #1
    draw.rectangle([TABLE_X, y, TABLE_X + TABLE_W, y + ROW_H], fill=row_bg)

    # Bottom border
    draw.rectangle([TABLE_X, y + ROW_H - 1, TABLE_X + TABLE_W, y + ROW_H], fill=(30, 35, 42))

    rx = TABLE_X + 12

    # Rank number
    rank_color = AMBER if rank <= 3 else TEXT_PRIMARY
    if rank == 1:
        rank_color = ELECTRIC_BLUE
    draw.text((rx, y + 12), f"{rank:2d}", fill=rank_color, font=FONT_TABLE_RANK)
    rx += COL_RANK_W

    # Trend indicator
    trend_color = TEXT_MUTED
    trend_char = trend
    if trend == "▲":
        trend_color = GREEN
    elif trend == "▼":
        trend_color = RED_SOFT
    elif trend == "N":
        trend_color = PINK
        trend_char = "✦"
    draw.text((rx, y + 14), trend_char, fill=trend_color, font=FONT_TABLE_TREND)
    rx += COL_TREND_W

    # Repository name
    cat_color = CAT_LABELS[cat][1]
    # Draw category dot
    draw.ellipse([rx, y + 18, rx + 8, y + 26], fill=cat_color)
    draw.text((rx + 14, y + 14), repo, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=FONT_TABLE_REPO)
    rx += COL_REPO_W

    # Bar + stars
    star_val = int(stars.replace("+", "").replace(",", ""))
    bar_w = int((star_val / MAX_STARS) * COL_BAR_W)
    bar_color = cat_color
    if rank == 1:
        bar_color = ELECTRIC_BLUE
    draw_bar(draw, rx, y + 20, bar_w, COL_BAR_W, bar_color, height=8)
    rx += COL_BAR_W + 8

    # Star count
    draw.text((rx, y + 12), stars, fill=GREEN if rank <= 5 else TEXT_PRIMARY, font=FONT_TABLE_STARS)

    y += ROW_H

# ── Key Takeaways section ──────────────────────────────────────────────
y += 20
draw.rectangle([36, y, W - 36, y + 1], fill=BORDER)
y += 14
draw.text((36, y), "Key Takeaways", fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=FONT_SECTION)
y += 30

for i, (title, body) in enumerate(TAKEAWAYS):
    # Numbered circle
    cx, cy = 52, y + 8
    circle_color = [ELECTRIC_BLUE, PURPLE, GREEN][i]
    draw.ellipse([cx - 12, cy - 12, cx + 12, cy + 12], fill=circle_color)
    # Number
    num_font = font("liberation/LiberationMono-Bold.ttf", 14)
    nbbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), str(i + 1), font=num_font)
    nw = nbbox[2] - nbbox[0]
    nh = nbbox[3] - nbbox[1]
    draw.text((cx - nw // 2, cy - nh // 2 - 2), str(i + 1), fill=(0, 0, 0), font=num_font)

    # Title
    draw.text((76, y), title, fill=circle_color, font=FONT_TAKEAWAY_TITLE)
    y += 24
    # Body - wrap text
    wrapped = textwrap.fill(body, width=72)
    draw.text((76, y), wrapped, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=FONT_TAKEAWAY_BODY)
    y += 44

# ── Footer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
y = H - 40
draw.rectangle([0, y - 10, W, y - 10], fill=BORDER)
draw.text((36, y), "Data: star-history.com  ·  Week of Apr 9–15, 2026", fill=TEXT_MUTED, font=FONT_FOOTER)

# ── Save ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG")
print("Poster saved to /app/output/final_poster.png")

print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H}")

        r = r_out if i % 2 == 0 else r_in
        points.append((cx + r * math.cos(angle), cy - r * math.sin(angle)))
    draw.polygon(points, fill=fill)

    draw.text((x + 7, y + 2), label, fill=color, font=F_TAG)

def text_width(draw, text, font):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]

                           fill=(color[0]//4, color[1]//4, color[2]//4),
                           outline=color, width=1)
    draw.text((x + 7, y + 2), label, fill=color, font=F_TAG)

def text_width(draw, text, font):
    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), text, font=font)
    return bbox[2] - bbox[0]

def right_align_text(draw, x_right, y, text, font, fill):
    tw = text_width(draw, text, font)
    draw.text((x_right - tw, y), text, fill=fill, font=font)

# ── Build Image ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

# ── Header ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
HEADER_H = 110
# Darker header band
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, HEADER_H], fill=(8, 10, 15))
# Electric blue accent line at top
draw.rectangle([0, 0, W, 3], fill=ELECTRIC_BLUE)

y = 22
# Draw a star icon instead of emoji
draw_star(draw, 52, y + 20, 18, 8, AMBER)
draw.text((80, y), "Coding AI Leaderboard", fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=F_TITLE)
y += 48
draw.text((80, y), "Top GitHub Repos by Weekly Star Growth  ·  Apr 9–15, 2026", fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=F_SUBTITLE)

# Separator
y = HEADER_H
draw.rectangle([36, y, W - 36, y + 1], fill=BORDER)

# ── Metrics row ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
y = HEADER_H + 14
CARD_GAP = 10
CARD_W = (W - 36 * 2 - CARD_GAP * 3) // 4
CARD_H = 82
mx = 36
accent_colors = [ELECTRIC_BLUE, GREEN, PURPLE, AMBER]

for i, m in enumerate(METRICS):
    draw.rounded_rectangle([mx, y, mx + CARD_W, y + CARD_H],
                           radius=8, fill=BG_CARD, outline=BORDER, width=1)
    # Colored top accent
    draw.rectangle([mx + 2, y + 2, mx + CARD_W - 2, y + 4], fill=accent_colors[i])
    # Value
    draw.text((mx + 14, y + 10), m["value"], fill=accent_colors[i], font=F_MET_VAL)
    # Label
    draw.text((mx + 14, y + 44), m["label"], fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=F_MET_LBL)
    # Context
    draw.text((mx + 14, y + 60), m["ctx"], fill=TEXT_MUTED, font=F_MET_CTX)
    mx += CARD_W + CARD_GAP

y += CARD_H + 14

# ── Category legend ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
draw.text((36, y), "CATEGORIES", fill=TEXT_MUTED, font=F_TAG)
lx = 130
for cat_key in ["agent", "claude", "design", "utility", "new"]:
    cat_label, cat_color = CAT_LABELS[cat_key]
    draw_tag(draw, lx, y - 1, cat_label, cat_color)
    lx += len(cat_label) * 7 + 26

y += 24

# ── Section title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
draw.text((36, y), "Full Weekly Top 20 Ranking", fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=F_SECTION)
y += 28

# ── Table ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
TBL_X = 28
TBL_W = W - 56
ROW_H = 46
# Column positions (absolute x from TBL_X)
C_RANK   = TBL_X + 14
C_TREND  = C_RANK + 38
C_DOT    = C_TREND + 26
C_REPO   = C_DOT + 16
C_BAR    = C_REPO + 390
C_STARS  = TBL_X + TBL_W - 20  # right-aligned

# Table header row
draw.rounded_rectangle([TBL_X, y, TBL_X + TBL_W, y + ROW_H],
                       radius=6, fill=(30, 36, 44))
draw.text((C_RANK, y + 14), "#", fill=TEXT_MUTED, font=F_TBL_HDR)
draw.text((C_REPO - 2, y + 14), "Repository", fill=TEXT_MUTED, font=F_TBL_HDR)
draw.text((C_BAR, y + 14), "Stars", fill=TEXT_MUTED, font=F_TBL_HDR)
y += ROW_H

MAX_STARS = 9715
BAR_MAX_W = 180

for r in REPOS:
    rank = r["rank"]
    trend = r["trend"]
    repo = r["repo"]
    stars = r["stars"]
    cat = r["cat"]
    cat_label, cat_color = CAT_LABELS[cat]

    # Row background
    row_bg = BG_ROW_ODD if rank % 2 == 1 else BG_ROW_EVEN
    if rank == 1:
        row_bg = (18, 26, 42)  # Blue tint for #1
    if rank <= 3:
        row_bg = tuple(min(255, c + 4) for c in row_bg)  # Slightly brighter for top 3

    draw.rectangle([TBL_X, y, TBL_X + TBL_W, y + ROW_H], fill=row_bg)
    # Row bottom border
    draw.rectangle([TBL_X, y + ROW_H - 1, TBL_X + TBL_W, y + ROW_H], fill=(28, 33, 40))

    # ── Rank ──
    if rank == 1:
        rc = ELECTRIC_BLUE
    elif rank == 2:
        rc = (200, 200, 210)
    elif rank == 3:
        rc = AMBER
    else:
        rc = TEXT_SECONDARY
    draw.text((C_RANK, y + 12), f"{rank:2d}", fill=rc, font=F_RANK)

    # ── Trend ──
    tc = TEXT_MUTED
    tch = trend
    if trend == "▲":
        tc = GREEN
    elif trend == "▼":
        tc = RED_SOFT
    elif trend == "N":
        tc = PINK
        tch = "NEW"
        draw.text((C_TREND, y + 14), tch, fill=tc, font=F_TAG)
        tch = None
    if tch and tch != "NEW":
        draw.text((C_TREND, y + 14), tch, fill=tc, font=F_TREND)

    # ── Category dot ──
    draw.ellipse([C_DOT, y + 16, C_DOT + 8, y + 24], fill=cat_color)

    # ── Repo name ──
    # Truncate if too long
    max_repo_w = C_BAR - C_REPO - 10
    repo_display = repo
    while text_width(draw, repo_display, F_REPO) > max_repo_w and len(repo_display) > 10:
        repo_display = repo_display[:-4] + "..."
    draw.text((C_REPO, y + 14), repo_display, fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=F_REPO)

    # ── Bar ──
    star_val = int(stars.replace("+", "").replace(",", ""))
    bar_w = max(4, int((star_val / MAX_STARS) * BAR_MAX_W))
    bar_c = cat_color
    if rank == 1:
        bar_c = ELECTRIC_BLUE
    # Background bar
    draw.rounded_rectangle([C_BAR, y + 18, C_BAR + BAR_MAX_W, y + 26],
                           radius=3, fill=(30, 35, 42))
    # Foreground bar
    draw.rounded_rectangle([C_BAR, y + 18, C_BAR + bar_w, y + 26],
                           radius=3, fill=bar_c)

    # ── Star count (right-aligned) ──
    sc = GREEN if rank <= 5 else TEXT_PRIMARY
    right_align_text(draw, C_STARS, y + 12, stars, sc, F_STARS)

    y += ROW_H

# ── Key Takeaways ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
y += 16
draw.rectangle([36, y, W - 36, y + 1], fill=BORDER)
y += 12
draw.text((36, y), "Key Takeaways", fill=TEXT_PRIMARY, font=F_SECTION)
y += 28

for i, (title, body, color) in enumerate(TAKEAWAYS):
    # Numbered circle
    cx, cy = 52, y + 8
    draw.ellipse([cx - 13, cy - 13, cx + 13, cy + 13], fill=color)
    nfont = fnt("liberation/LiberationMono-Bold.ttf", 14)
    ntxt = str(i + 1)
    nw = text_width(draw, ntxt, nfont)
    draw.text((cx - nw // 2, cy - 9), ntxt, fill=(0, 0, 0), font=nfont)

    # Title
    draw.text((76, y), title, fill=color, font=F_TK_TITLE)
    y += 22
    # Body
    wrapped = textwrap.fill(body, width=76)
    draw.text((76, y), wrapped, fill=TEXT_SECONDARY, font=F_TK_BODY)
    y += 42

# ── Footer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fy = H - 36
draw.rectangle([0, fy - 10, W, fy - 10], fill=BORDER)
draw.text((36, fy), "Data: star-history.com  ·  Week of Apr 9–15, 2026", fill=TEXT_MUTED, font=F_FOOTER)

# ── Save ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
img.save("/app/output/final_poster.png", "PNG")
print(f"Poster saved: {W}x{H}")
